raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

With early decode allocation, completed optimistic prefills can occupy every request slot while waiting for bootstrap. If decode admits different requests, those requests cannot start prefill, leaving both sides waiting.

## Modifications

Keep completed prefills parked normally. Reclaim a parked request when the request pool is full and queued work needs admission, including bootstrap requests blocked by metadata exhaustion. Release metadata when an exhausted optimistic attempt returns to bootstrap. Preserve parking for `prefill_complete` allocation.

The reclaim regression uses a CPU request pool to check parking without contention and reclaiming only one slot under pressure. The existing retry test checks metadata cleanup on bootstrap fallback.

## Accuracy Tests

With test dependencies installed:

```bash
PYTHONPATH=python uv run --no-project python -m pytest test/registered/unit/disaggregation/test_prefill_complete_integration.py test/registered/unit/disaggregation/test_prefill_result_polling.py test/registered/unit/disaggregation/test_prefill_abort_result_cleanup.py -q
```

Passed: **75 tests and 82 subtests**. GPU model-output tests were not run.

```bash
uv run --no-project python -m pre_commit run --hook-stage pre-commit --files python/sglang/srt/disaggregation/prefill.py test/registered/unit/disaggregation/test_prefill_complete_integration.py
```

Passed all applicable hooks, including the registered-test checks.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

No throughput or latency benchmark was run. The regression verifies that reclamation stops once a request slot is free and that completed prefills remain parked without contention.

## Checklist

- [x] Format code with pre-commit.
- [x] Add unit tests.
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style.
- [x] Documentation: no user-facing configuration changes.
- [ ] GPU accuracy and speed benchmarks.
